text:
Predicates:
German(x) ::: x is German.
Russian(x) ::: x is Russian.
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
MemberOf(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Parliament(x) ::: x is a parliament.
Reichstag(x) ::: x is a Reichstag.
Premises:
HeinrichSchmidt :: Heinrich Schmidt was a German politician.
HeinrichSchmidt :: Heinrich Schmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
German(HeinrichSchmidt) ∨ Russian(HeinrichSchmidt) ::: Heinrich Schmidt was German or Russian or both.
